main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Invert the map ✝️ to awaken ❤️: you are asleep 🧠 in an illusion ┻
header_desc: The union of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the integration of science and spirituality, allowing us to understand our place in the cosmos. The origin of the universe resides in the right hemisphere —the pneuma—, open to the timeless and divine, while the left —the psyche— binds us to the temporal, material, and the end of the universe. This reveals that the divine spark is an inalienable essence of the human being.
left_title: The Return of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Kingdom of Light
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity, demonstrating that human existence transcends both matter and spacetime. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ ❤️ and the material |EGO⟩ 🧠. This grants us a free will of perception, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩. In general relativity, matter tells spacetime how to curve, and spacetime tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the temporal and material illusion of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia can we understand that the statement "the Father and I are one" is a call to dissolve the "false self" to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells: the timeless and divine reality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is inside you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere (the origin of the universe), while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left (the end of the universe), thus revealing the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us towards a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and the spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why the laws of Newton and Maxwell do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's rupture of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual ensemble Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home but as a prison for the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god unaware of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, waiting for the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox, boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos —with its over two trillion galaxies— is where the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: "The Father and I are one." Could this have had a hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, bigger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the sum of the physical laws governing the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
